{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify the QA rows: revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Check if these QA rows affect the conversion rate calculation
# They are included in the total count of orders, so they must be removed
# because they are not real orders and should not be part of the analysis

# Remove QA rows from the dataset
sales_clean = sales[~sales.index.isin(qa_rows.index)]

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = sales_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference: email minus paid_search
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print the results
difference, conversion_rates"}
